visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a shot of the interior of a green military vehicle. The cabin is dimly lit with artificial light, revealing storage racks, a fire extinguisher, and various mechanical panels. Large white text identifies the vehicle as an AAV7 amphibious assault vehicle. (2) Five individuals, four men and one woman, are seated on benches inside the green cabin. They are dressed in camouflage military uniforms and wear hard hats in colors of blue, yellow, and red. They are facing each other and the camera, talking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (3) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the personnel checking fluid levels. Close-ups focus on hands in black gloves pulling out metal dipsticks and pointing to oil markers. Bright variety-style text boxes pop up with the word "合格!" (Passed) next to items like engine oil and transmission fluid. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor setting with an overcast sky. Men in camouflage and yellow hard hats are using a large mallet to strike the treads of the camouflaged amphibious vehicle. One man swings the tool with effort while others stand nearby watching and gesturing. (5) The final phase returns to the interior cabin where the main group is laughing and joking. Speech bubbles and variety text appear above their heads, emphasizing their humorous reactions. The woman and the men are seen smiling and laughing together in the confined space.
